The Saffire-I experiment begins only after Cygnus is unberthed from the ISS.

evidence.quote: This material will be expected to burn at the anticipated oxygen mole fraction of the

nominal_atmosphere.note: O2 only, near 21 percent: a pre-flight expectation for the Saffire-I panel ('will be expected'); the subscript 2 is on the next printed line. The experimental table reports 21.5 to 21.7 percent measured. No source gives the cabin pressure.

evidence.quote: The objective of the Saffire-I experiment is to investigate flame spread and growth in low-gravity.
investigate the low-g flammability limits compared to those obtained in NASA’s normal gravity material flammability screening test

pillars.note: The Saffire-I-specific objective is flame spread and growth (paper, p. 4; DoD para 1). The low-g flammability-limit objective is stated for the SAFFIRE series (first sentence of DoD para 1), not for Saffire-I alone; it is the prevention pillar. Pillar is the curator's classification and the weakest one here: the reviewer should decide.
